summary.text: Adrian Cortes, a Democrat from Battle Ground, was elected in 2024 to represent the 18th Legislative District in the Washington State Senate.
He is vice chair of the Business, Financial Services & Trade Committee and a member of the Early Learning & K-12 Education and Transportation committees.

paragraphs.text: Cortes moved to the 18th Legislative District when he was 6 years old and has lived there ever since, according to his Senate Democratic Caucus biography.
He is a second-career teacher who taught special education for 12 years in the Camas School District and is now a field supervisor for ESD 112, overseeing pre-service teachers.
He previously chaired the Battle Ground Planning Commission and was later elected to the Battle Ground City Council for three terms.
He also chaired C-Tran, the regional transit authority in Clark County, and served as mayor of Battle Ground from 2020 to 2021.
Cortes resides in Battle Ground, where he is co-parenting his youngest daughter.
